cases.name: read_query
cases.description: Execute a SELECT query on the SQLite database
cases.labelNote: Handler accepts only a SELECT-leading query. Does not claim arbitrary SQL query semantics.

cases.name: write_query
cases.description: Execute an INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE query on the SQLite database
cases.labelNote: Handler executes SQL other than SELECT; DELETE is permitted.

cases.name: create_table
cases.description: Create a new table in the SQLite database
